items.blurb: The money goes towards shipping developer boards next year.

items.title: Popular coding assistant adds an offline mode
items.blurb: Falls back to a smaller local model when there is no connection.

topics.description: Breaches, patches and actively exploited bugs. Hourly alerts for CISA KEV entries.

report.headline: Sample: two VPN appliances get urgent patches for flaws already being exploited.
report.summary: This is sample data: two vendors fixed remote-code bugs in VPN gateways under active attack. Patch those gateways first.

items.title: CVE-2026-00001: Example Networks VPN Gateway — auth bypass

items.blurb: Rotate admin credentials after patching, the advisory says.

items.title: Logging library fixes a denial-of-service bug
items.blurb: Crafted log lines could exhaust memory; version 3.4.2 fixes it.

items.title: Parcel-delivery phishing kit spreads by SMS
items.blurb: Targets phones with fake delivery-fee payment pages.

items.title: example-org/tiny-agents (+1,214 stars)

items.title: sample-labs/whisper-home (+512 stars)

items.title: demo-team/prompt-diff (+301 stars)
items.blurb: Compare model outputs for two prompt versions side by side.

items.title: example-org/voices-20 — multilingual text-to-speech
items.blurb: Twenty voices across eight languages, Apache-2.0 licence.
